speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal CBC helps rule out severe bacterial infection or leukemia, supporting a hypersensitivity reaction. Since the symptoms started one week after amoxicillin initiation and include fever, urticaria, and arthralgia without angioedema or respiratory distress, this presentation is classic for a serum sickness-like reaction.
